rationale: The inline success shape is extracted as ConnectApplicationClientSecret so the response has a stable named schema without changing its fields.

object.description: Distinguishes the connect application secret object.

id.description: The unique ID of the client secret.

secret_hint.description: A hint showing the last few characters of the secret value.

last_used_at.description: The timestamp when the client secret was last used, or null if never used.

provenance.observed: The operation declares its ConnectApplicationClientSecret success shape inline at /paths/~1connect~1applications~1{id}~1client_secrets/get/responses/200/content/application~1json/schema/items.
provenance.specd: The SDK exposes the same success shape through the named ConnectApplicationClientSecret component.
